title: Audit-log facility stamp and event types
description: Formal shape of audit-log.yaml — the machine stamp of the audit-log facility (DEC-044) and the event types it builds and parses, each with the family of the seam that posts it and its payload fields. `scripts/_lib/audit_log.py` is the one builder and parser. Companion per COR-018 / the .pkit/schemas/ area conventions.

version.description: The version of the stamp's grammar, written as `v=<version>`.

act_field.description: The field that carries the id made once for each act.

legacy.description: Stamps written before the facility, which the parser still reads.

events.description: Event types. Keys are the stamp's `event` values; values match $defs.entry.

event_ref.description: Narrowed cross-schema reference token (COR-019) pointing at an event type in `audit-log.yaml`.

field_name.description: A payload field's name, as the stamp writes it.

family.description: The seam that posts the event: the ownership seam (ADR-041) or the state-issue seam (ADR-071).

fields.description: The payload's fields, in the order the stamp writes them.

required.description: The fields an event of this type cannot do without.

summary.description: What the event records, for a person.

entry.description: One event type of the facility.
